name: toast-stack
title: Toast stack
description: Feedback with a little sense of space.
docs: Import { ToastStack } from your configured components alias under bera/toast-stack. Keep its companion CSS. Adapt the stack geometry to the existing toast provider. This reference uses a local Preview toast control; preserve the host provider's lifecycle, expiry, pause, live region, and dismissal semantics. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/toast-stack.agent.md
